title: Logarithmically many contractions on the aggregate binary Hayes identity path
statement: Let ell >= 200, let n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, put c_0=ell-ceil(log2 ell)-2, and let A_i be the Haar-weighted sum over all retained levels of the sibling-difference square mass above the identity in E_i. Let U_(ell,n) be the proved individual-Weil envelope for A_0 and let T_(ell,n) be the largest integral A_(c_0) allowed by the sharp zero-sum implication to REL. If r is the least integer with 2^r T_(ell,n) >= U_(ell,n), then at least r indices i satisfy 2 A_i <= A_(i-1).

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; sharp aggregate identity-path bridge to REL

notes: The native identity_cylinder_aggregate_path_implication operation proves this statement implies REL directly and checks every integer in the sharp one-sided allowance. At ell=200 it asks for 18 half-balanced aggregate steps for n=401 and 19 for n=402, versus 20 separate steps on every retained Haar level under the stronger F:gf2-hayes-identity-path-half-balance statement. Translation f(x)->f(x+1) proves one exact aggregate split, leaving 17 and 18 respectively. Exact-source e046d1d05 fleet controls for both endpoints and 19<=ell<=23 find all 140 aggregate steps three-quarter-balanced and 69 half-balanced; these diagnostics are deliberately not attached as universal proof evidence. ADR-0583 identifies each signed split imbalance with an exact low-conductor layer of a shifted second moment over only the high Hayes spectrum, after conditional variance cancels the low block. No Autogenesis operation is registered because no uniform checker establishes the remaining decorrelation inequalities.
